# يُسْتَوْضَحُ (yustawḍaḥu) /jus.taw.dˤa.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# يَسْتَوْضِحَ (yastawḍiḥa) /jas.taw.dˤi.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْ
